- **Checked, no change:** I compared all 39 test files under `test/store/`. 38 were pass → pass and 1 had no result at the earlier commit. The 1 with no result is `test/store/key-shadow.test.ts`, which passes now, but Squeal didn't select it for the change, so there is no earlier result to compare. I also compared the six other test files that import `store/mark`, and all were pass → pass. Those are `test/daemon/mark-binding.test.ts`, `test/daemon/store-fault.test.ts`, `test/daemon/store-fault-daemon.test.ts`, `test/daemon/full-check.test.ts`, `test/daemon/full-check-daemon.test.ts` and `test/harness/store-fault-hook.test.ts`.
- **`test/store/open.test.ts`:** it is pass → pass, but the two sides ran different versions of the file. The earlier side ran it without the new 27 lines, so its tests are not the same set. The new tests pass at 20f03a431. They weren't in the file at the earlier commit, so I haven't shown that they fail without the `mark.ts` fix. `squeal proof test/store/open.test.ts --base a5c9b7223` would show that.
- **Not checked:** Squeal's closure for this change selects 1338 test files. The full comparison hadn't finished when I stopped, because those files were still queued. The 624 files outside the closure have no result at the earlier commit.

If you want the full 1338-file comparison, `squeal status --at '20f03a431~1' --wait 100000` waits for the queued runs.
